The Authentic Voice of Barriere: The Bear 93.1

Discover the soul of radio at The Bear 93.1! Standing tall as a beacon of independence, we're one of the few radio stations that remain true to their roots. We're more than just airwaves; we're the heart and sound of Barriere. With Ken Brown at the helm, we are steadfast in our mission to bring you up-to-the-minute regional news, celebrate Canadian talents, and foster a sense of community.  Around the clock, every day of the year, The Bear is here for you. Our lineup features a mix of local legends and passionate hosts, curating shows that resonate with our listeners. From the rich tapestry of national programs to the thrilling updates on Vancouver Canucks games, we've got it all. Dive deeper into our story, learn about our promising future, and tune in for a radio experience like no other. Embrace the roar of The Bear 93.1!
